description: Find and verify emails for up to 100 people. Use create_job for a larger list. 1 credit per verified result. Free outcomes still return at 0 credits. Rows run until a billable result cannot be paid for; later rows are skipped with insufficient_credits and https://www.findleademails.com/pricing. This stores the lookups. It does not delete data.

records.description: People to look up. Each record uses the same fields as find_email.

company_domain.description: Company website domain, such as example.com. Optional when company_linkedin_url is set.

company_linkedin_url.description: The company's LinkedIn page. Resolved to a domain only when company_domain is empty. Costs 1 credit only when a domain is found.

name: find_emails_bulk

results.description: One row per input record, in the order given.

email.description: The address found, or null when there is none to return.

needs_verification.description: True when the address could not be confirmed, for example on a catch-all domain.

status.description: verified, catch_all, predicted, not_found, insufficient_evidence, invalid_input or error, or skipped when the row was not looked up.

credits_used.description: Credits this call spent. 0 for a free outcome.

title: Find emails in bulk
